description: Agent Trust and Compliance: live checks an agent runs before it trusts a counterparty. POST /v1/preflight (url, domain, address, chain?, name?, since?): every check that applies plus the OFAC SDN wallet-address list and brand-lookalike findings, one verdict (pass, warn, fail, unknown); each check has result, method and evidence_hash. POST /v1/domain-trust (domain): RDAP and DNS, a 0-100 score. POST /v1/brand-verify (domain, brand_name?): live TLS. POST /v1/seller-trust (url): both combined. POST /v1/sanctions-check (address): the U.S. Consolidated Screening List. POST /v1/reputation (chain: eth, base, arbitrum or polygon; address): Blockscout for eth, else Pocket public RPC plus Sourcify and ENS (coverage basic, max 60). Scores are 0-100 with a reasons array. Lookups to private or loopback targets are refused. Every response is a JSON object.

rpc_types.backend_hint: agent-trust HTTP server on :8080; mount at /
rpc_types.notes: Only POST /v1/preflight, /v1/domain-trust, /v1/brand-verify, /v1/seller-trust, /v1/sanctions-check, /v1/reputation and GET /v1/version, /v1/health are expected. Bad input returns 4xx with a JSON error object.

specs.notes: Covers all six resources in one document.

serving.backend: The agent-trust Node.js HTTP server (no external dependencies) behind a RelayMiner, REST backend at http://<container>:8080. It calls rdap.org and data.iana.org (RDAP bootstrap), the domain under test (DNS and TLS on :443), data.trade.gov, www.treasury.gov (OFAC SDN list), eth.blockscout.com, sourcify.dev and Pocket Network's public RPC, so it needs broad outbound HTTPS, DNS and TLS.

healthcheck.notes: Identity probe: pins the backend to this service.
Functional probe: live RDAP and DNS for example.com; asserts the score is a number.

serving.notes: Request bodies are capped at 1 MiB; responses are usually a few KB. Each upstream call has an 8 s timeout with one retry, so use a relay timeout of 30 s. /v1/sanctions-check needs TRADE_GOV_SUBSCRIPTION_KEY (free from developer.trade.gov); without it, it returns 422 not_configured, never a false clean result. Gateway operators: configure as type passthrough with rpc_types ["rest"].
